2608.12984.title: Reconcile Once, Write Anytime: A Trust-Tiered Librarian and a Multi-Agent Writer for Drift-Free, Point-in-Time Research
2608.12984.paper_summary: Long-form research reports generated by large language models drift, contradict themselves, and lose provenance: the same metric appears with different values, and rumor is quoted as confidently as an audited filing. We present a two-tier agentic system that separates a maintained, point-in-time knowledge library from report writing. A deterministic "librarian" ingests timestamped sources into a trust-tiered ontology, layering evidence cards, an authoritative metric ledger, and a claim graph into an always-current source of truth, not per-query RAG over raw chunks. A portable multi-agent "writer" runtime then composes a contradiction-free, evidence-grounded report at any knowledge cutoff T, reading only evidence with as_of <= T (no look-ahead); red-team verdicts flow back into the librarian. We evaluate on a self-collected, public corpus of 6,130 sources yielding 555,926 evidence cards (SEC EDGAR filings across 295 issuers and 11 sectors, U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics releases, and Wikipedia). From the one library we compose four point-in-time reports on distinct theses and run eight reproducible experiments, whose headline metrics come from a deterministic quality-control gate, itself validated by defect-injection meta-evaluation at recall 1.0 and precision 1.0. A shared metric ledger removes 6,845 cross-section contradictions to zero. Tier-first selection is correct on 22/22 gold cases where a popularity-first baseline scores only 9/22; trust tiering leaks zero media-sourced numbers, and no government statistic displaces a company's own filing. A red-team refutation propagates back and self-corrects a later run with zero manual edits. Replay exhibits zero look-ahead violations across seven cutoffs while the library grows from 235,373 to 555,312 cards. Difficulty-tiered model routing exceeds the all-Opus quality ceiling while running 3.7x faster than serial.
2608.12984.paper_summary_zh: 長篇研究報告由大型語言模型生成，會漂移、自相矛盾，並失去來源：相同的指標出現不同的數值，而謠言被引用的信心與經過審核的檔案相同。我們提出了一個兩層的代理系統，將維護的、特定時間點的知識庫與報告撰寫分開。一個確定性的「圖書管理員」將帶有時間戳的來源納入信任分層本體，將證據卡、權威指標分類帳和主張圖層疊加到一個始終當前的真相來源，而不是對原始片段的每次查詢進行RAG。一個可攜式的多代理「撰寫者」運行時則在任何知識截止時間T上組成一份無矛盾、以證據為基礎的報告，只閱讀as_of <= T的證據（不進行前瞻）；紅隊的裁決會流回圖書管理員。我們在自收集的公共語料庫中進行評估，該語料庫包含6,130個來源，產生555,926張證據卡（涵蓋295個發行者和11個行業的SEC EDGAR檔案、美國勞工統計局發布的資料以及維基百科）。從這個圖書館中，我們撰寫了四份針對不同論題的特定時間點報告，並進行了八個可重現的實驗，這些實驗的主要指標來自一個確定性的質量控制閘，該閘本身經過缺陷注入的元評估，在召回率1.0和精確率1.0下得到驗證。一個共享的指標分類帳消除了6,845個橫斷面矛盾，達到零。層級優先的選擇在22/22個金標案例中是正確的，而以人氣為優先的基準僅得9/22；信任分層未洩漏任何媒體來源的數字，且沒有政府統計取代公司的自有檔案。一個紅隊的反駁會回傳並自我修正後續的運行，無需手動編輯。重播在七個截止時間上展現出零前瞻違規，同時圖書館的卡片數量從235,373增長到555,312。難度分層的模型路由超過了所有作品的質量上限，同時運行速度比串行快3.7倍。
